request: "Observed defect in the DES command-line tool, measured on 2026-09-04 on this repository.

`des code-fact query.callers-of resolve_declared_capability --root .` exits 0 and answers `{confidence: binding-resolved, provider: graphify, payload.sites: []}`, although the symbol has real callers in src/des/adapters/driven/task_invocation/claude_code_task_adapter.py (lines 21 and 235) and in tests/des/unit/adapters/driven/task_invocation/test_claude_code_task_adapter.py (lines 16 and 302). The same happens for `_schema_for`, called at claude_code_task_adapter.py line 134. The graphify index does contain the symbol and the `calls` edges to it. After the fix, the same query reports the real caller sites at `binding-resolved` confidence, while a genuinely uncalled in-root symbol still answers a verified empty caller set at `binding-resolved`, as ADR-LA-001 law LA1-L11 requires.
"

# Product Owner
Use the exact Request and only needed existing product authority once. Accept an
unchanged `SINGLE` or return one ordered sequence of independently shippable
observable values through provider-enforced typed IPC. Make the
first ordered value the thinnest end-to-end public-surface observation (a
walking skeleton), never a dormant technical prerequisite. If the runner
supplies a not-yet-started suffix with an opaque design finding, return one
distinct corrected suffix whose every value is publicly observable through the
real driving port; already started values are preserved by software, which
alone replaces the handover. Never
write an authority, charter, scaffold, coordination file or handover. Its
structured output contains `accepted | rejected | indeterminate`, one opaque
`diagnostic`, and only the typed ordered `values`; terminal prose is never a
source of product facts.
